speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a significant medical history; could you please tell me which conditions you have been diagnosed with previously? Additionally, are your gait and limb ataxia progressive, and have they been present since childhood or did they develop later in life?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has anyone noticed involuntary jerking movements in your limbs or eyes, and do you experience any numbness or tingling in your hands or feet? Also, have you had any recent falls or head trauma?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: That explains the neurological symptoms, as natalizumab is known to increase the risk of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast. Have you noticed any changes in your vision, speech, or memory recently?
